overview: The School Committee approved a successor collective bargaining agreement with the Massachusetts Nurses Association, authorized the 2025-2026 school handbooks, and passed the first reading of a new generative AI policy.

items.title: MNA Collective Bargaining Successor Agreement
items.summary: The committee convened in executive session and subsequently approved a successor collective bargaining agreement with the Massachusetts Nurses Association running through fiscal year 2028.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine bills, payrolls, a computer monitor donation from TrueSearch, a vocational-technical culinary field trip to Rhode Island, and meeting minutes from September 8, 2025.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Student Advisory Council
items.summary: Members of the Student Advisory Council outlined their plans to champion student voice and increase representation during the school year.

items.title: Preliminary Enrollment Report
items.summary: Interim Superintendent Galusi presented a preliminary report indicating a slight decrease in district enrollment compared to the prior year.

items.title: Project Manager Position Update
items.summary: Approved updating the proposed project manager job description to 'building systems/project manager' to oversee complex HVAC and mechanical systems.

items.title: CCSR Cummings Foundation Grant Update
items.summary: Tabled the approval of a $35,000 Cummings Foundation grant for the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility pending a clarified agreement letter.

items.title: Policy on Generative AI (First Reading)
items.summary: Approved the first reading of a new policy regulating the ethical and educational use of generative AI in schools, with amendments addressing environmental impact, cognitive decline, and bias checking.

items.title: School Handbooks Approval
items.summary: Approved the 2025-2026 family and student handbooks, which incorporate updated school hours, religious curricular accommodations, and new generative AI guidelines.

items.title: Resolution on Bus Safety and Supervision
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the superintendent to present a report at the next meeting addressing safety and supervision on district school buses.

items.title: MSBA High School Building Project Update
items.summary: Presented a timeline for the high school feasibility study and designer selection process, and approved a motion to invite the selected designer to present at an upcoming meeting.

items.title: Resolution on Intra-District Enrollment Policy
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the Strategic and Capital Planning Subcommittee to draft an intra-district elementary enrollment approval policy before kindergarten registration.

items.title: Resolution on Strategic Plan and Superintendent Hiring
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the Strategic Planning Subcommittee to develop a timeline and process for a new district strategic plan that will inform the permanent superintendent hiring process.

items.title: Resolution on Interim Superintendent Evaluation Process
items.summary: Approved a timeline and focused performance indicators for the evaluation of the interim superintendent.
